line.en: Paste a Kafka config and see where messages could be lost, repeated or reordered, with a link to the Kafka docs for each point. It runs in your browser and on the command line.
line.he: מדביקים הגדרות של קפקא ורואים איפה הודעות עלולות ללכת לאיבוד, לחזור או להתערבב בסדר, עם קישור לתיעוד של קפקא לכל נקודה. עובד בדפדפן ובשורת הפקודה.

limit: It reads only the settings you paste and cannot see your code, your processing time or what happens when a broker fails.

works: Checks producer, consumer, broker, topic and Connect settings against 28 rules, each with a link to the Kafka docs
Hides values that look like secrets before anything is checked, and sends nothing anywhere
A command-line version that exits 1 on a risk, so a team can use it in CI
next: A ready-made GitHub Action for the command line
Rules for Kafka Streams and for change-data-capture setups
Rules drawn from real incidents, with the sources
later: Read a whole folder of configs and compare environments
Explain a consumer lag or rebalance problem from a few numbers
